landing.title: Guided intake
landing.intro: Choose the form that matches what you need. You can save a draft before submitting.
landing.legal_description: Share basic information so staff can route your request to an appropriate service.
landing.health_description: Share non-emergency information so staff can route your request.
form.legal_intro: Answer only what you are comfortable sharing.
form.health_intro: Answer only what you are comfortable sharing.
field.topic: What do you need help with?
field.details_hint: Do not include account numbers, Social Security numbers, or medical record numbers.
common.load_failed: The saved intake could not be loaded. Please try again.
common.ack_required: Please read and check the acknowledgment before submitting.
common.save_failed: The form could not be saved.
common.submitted: The form was submitted for routing. This does not confirm eligibility or an appointment.
disclaimer.legal: This form does not create an attorney-client relationship and is not legal advice.
disclaimer.health: This form is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or emergency care.
disclaimer.legal_ack: I understand that submitting this form does not create an attorney-client relationship.
disclaimer.health_ack: I understand that this form is not medical advice or emergency care.
disclaimer.urgent_heading: If you may be in immediate danger
disclaimer.urgent_body: Do not use this form for an emergency. Call 911 for immediate danger or 988 for a mental health crisis in the United States.
disclaimer.talk_person: If you can, contact a trusted person nearby.
disclaimer.save_without_ack: You may save a draft without agreeing to the acknowledgement, but you must acknowledge it before submitting.
